# Velair 1.9.0-beta.7

## 🛠️ Fixed

- Fixed climate restoration after a boost reapplying an unchanged HVAC mode or device preset. Combined climate commands now apply device options before the final temperature or temperature range, preventing a preset from overwriting the intended target with a stale value. The same ordering applies to grouped climates. Thanks to **@RonRoozendaal** for reporting [issue #59](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/59).

## 🚀 Improved

- Clarified which device settings are saved and restored after a Boost in the usage guide and all nine translations. Expanded technical guidance and manual checks for device presets, delayed state feedback and partial group failures.

## 🧭 Notes

- This beta follows [1.9.0-beta.6](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/releases/tag/v1.9.0-beta.6). Automated tests cover delayed state feedback, heating, cooling, temperature ranges and partial group failures. Validation on a physical evohome installation remains pending; device preset and override-duration behavior still depends on its Home Assistant integration.
- After updating through HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh the browser or Companion app.
